# Team Notes PRD

## Background
Support teams lose track of customer context because notes live in personal documents.
Leadership wants this fixed before the next quarterly planning cycle.

## Users
Customer support agents and their team leads use the product every day.

## Requirements
- Agents can attach a file to a note.
- Maximum upload size is 10 MB per file.
- Uploads are limited to 25 MB per file.
- The experience must be fast and intuitive.
- Notes are visible to every agent on the same team.

## Out of scope
Billing, SSO and mobile apps are not part of this release.
